safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts describe upper-lip swelling after prawn soup and timing of onset (~30 minutes after eating) but do not state the overall duration of symptoms as 'past 1 hour'.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the overall symptom duration (“past 1 hour”) slightly reduces clinical clarity about progression, but the clinically important timing (onset ~30 minutes after ingestion with worsening swelling/respiratory symptoms) is still captured and would not be expected to change emergent anaphylaxis management.

safety_verdicts.content: The patient initially experienced a weird sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies an initial 'weird feeling around the lips'; generated facts do not document this peri-lip weird sensation (they note swelling/pumping blood sensation instead).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting an initial “weird sensation around the lips” loses a minor prodromal symptom detail but does not materially alter recognition or treatment of the allergic reaction given the documented lip swelling and breathing difficulty.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No dizziness is captured in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Dizziness can be a marker of systemic involvement (e.g., hypotension) in anaphylaxis; omitting it could understate severity and affect downstream triage/monitoring decisions, even if emergency escalation was already initiated.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts gold and transcript: there were observable physical findings noted (appeared to have breathing problems; lips increasingly swelling). Stating 'No exam/vitals documented' is inconsistent with the documented observed findings.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting “no exam/vitals” can mislead subsequent clinicians into thinking there were no observed clinical signs, potentially downplaying reported/observed respiratory distress and worsening swelling and impacting handoff clarity and risk assessment.
